#### Description
Provides an implementation of `IPortfolioConstructionModel` that generates percent targets based on the `CompanyReference.IndustryTemplateCode`.

- Adds Unit Tests
  - Creates `BaseWeightingPortfolioConstructionModelTests`
  - Refactors EWPCMTests and IWPCMTests to inherit `BaseWeightingPortfolioConstructionModelTests` and prevent code duplication.
  - Adds `SectorWeightingPortfolioConstructionModelTests`

#### Related Issue
Closes #3984

#### Motivation and Context
Add Framework Models.

#### Requires Documentation Change
Yes. List this model in [Portfolio Construction Model](https://www.quantconnect.com/docs/algorithm-framework/portfolio-construction) section.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Unit tests and algorithm regression.

issue_context.title: Adds Sector Weighting Portfolio Construction Model
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Lean provides a PCM that emits targets that average over the security sector. For instance, if we have 3 sectors, each sector would get 33% that would be divided among securities of each sector. 

#### Actual Behavior
There is no Sector Weighting PCM.

#### Potential Solution
Implement SectorWeightingPortfolioConstructionModel

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)

review_comments: I think it would be nice if this regression test had some asserts on the order events quantities? To make sure the PCM is creating the correct targets based on the sectors
